description.value: DIP Co. Delights is a family-run gourmet sandwich shop in Deep Cove built around Focabari, the Daniali family's signature house-baked bread that fuses Italian focaccia with Persian barbari. Opened in 2022, the shop imports specialty cured meats, cheeses, and olive oils directly from Europe to craft bold European-Middle Eastern fusion sandwiches. Deep Cove is a popular cycling destination, making this a standout food stop for riders exploring the area.
